content_sections.heading: About NAM Kozhikode
content_sections.text: The National AYUSH Mission's District Programme Management & Supporting Unit (DPMSU) for Kozhikode works from the District Ayurveda Hospital, Bhatt Road, Westhill, Chungam-Kozhikode-673005. Both notices are signed by Dr. Anupama Dev A, District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, DPMSU, Kozhikode, Kerala. The posts are under the Mission's Indian Systems of Medicine Department and Homoeopathy Department.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The two notices list 18 posts. For every post, the number of vacancies is printed as "Anticipatory", and no fixed count is given.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notices give an educational qualification for each post. They do not mention any experience requirement. I. a) M.Sc (Clinical Psychology) or any other equivalent qualification from a UGC recognized University / Institute owned by Government of Kerala / National Institutes of Government of India. OR b) M.A / M.Sc in Psychology or any other equivalent qualification from a UGC recognized University / Institute owned by Government of Kerala / National Institutes of Government of India. II. M.Phil in Clinical Psychology or equivalent 2 year course from a RCI approved University/College/Institution owned by Government of Kerala/National Institutes of Government of India/UGC recognized University. III. Rehabilitation Council of India Registration as "Clinical Psychologist". BNYS / BAMS / MSc (Yoga) / Mphil (Yoga) from a recognized University, or PG Diploma in Yoga of minimum one year duration from a recognized University, or Approved Certificate course of one year duration in Yoga from a recognized University / Govt. Department, or YCB Certificate. Skill test eligibility is a must for all qualifications. BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences) / BAMS / M.Sc (Yoga) / M.Phil (Yoga) / Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (minimum one year duration) from a recognized University, or Approved Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) from a recognized University or Government Department, or Diploma in Yoga Teacher Training by SRC / YCB (Yoga Certification Board) Certificate, or Diploma in Yogic Science and Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala, or Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration). Each notice gives a maximum age only. No minimum age and no cut-off date for counting age is printed, and no age relaxation is mentioned. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Each post carries a fixed salary per month, as printed in the notices. No allowances are mentioned. All appointments are temporary appointments on a contract basis. The length of the contract and any renewal are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for both notices are accepted online only. Go to the website https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in . Fill in the application form for the post you are eligible for, making sure every detail is clear and accurate. Submit the online application on or before 30 November 2026. For queries, the DPMSU Kozhikode letterhead gives the mobile number 9249872611 and the email [email protected] . The selection process may include a Skill Test, Written Examination and Interview, as required. Candidates must produce their original documents at the time of the interview. For the Yoga Demonstrator post, skill test eligibility is a must for all qualifications.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be rejected without any further consideration. If the information furnished in the application does not match the original documents produced at the time of the interview, the candidate's application will be rejected. The number of vacancies is shown as "Anticipatory" for every post.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised in NAM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eighteen posts are advertised: 17 in notice NAM/DPMSU/KKD/NT-01/2026 and YOGA Instructor in notice NAM/DPMSU/KKD/NT-02/2026. The number of vacancies for each post is shown as "Anticipatory".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NAM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications is 30 November 2026, for both notices.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Cook and Security posts?
faq.answer: The qualification for both the Cook and the Security posts is SSLC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NAM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years for the 17 posts in notice NT-01/2026 and 50 years for YOGA Instructor in notice NT-02/2026. Candidates above these ages are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for NAM Kozhikode posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from 10,500/- per month for Cook to 32,000/- per month for Speech Therapist. Clinical Psychologist, Psychologist, Special Educator and Occupational Therapist each get 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NAM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the website https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 30 November 2026. Incomplete applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Skill Test, Written Examination and Interview, as required. Original documents are produced at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are the NAM Kozhikode posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary appointments on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the qualification for the Therapist posts?
faq.answer: Therapist-Male and Therapist-Female need the Ayurveda Therapist Course conducted by Govt. of Kerala/DAME, or the one-year Ayurveda Panchakarma Technician Course conducted by CCRAS Cheruthuruthy.

faq.question: Q10. Is RCI registration needed for the Audiologist and Clinical Psychologist posts?
faq.answer: Yes. RCI registration is compulsory for Audiologist, and Clinical Psychologist requires Rehabilitation Council of India Registration as "Clinical Psychologist".
